env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: The App library's id of the service beside it (ivendnext_ksc for the library's app): the retailers it reads are the ones that connected to that service.

env.name: KSC_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix of the app's names in the retailer's iVendNext, in capitals, as the service beside it has it (IVENDNEXT KSC for the library's app).

env.name: KSC_PAGE_URL
env.about: Where the kitchen's screens reach the service's page (https://kitchen-screen.example.app): only a page from there may open a line.

env.name: IVN_SHOPS_TABLE
env.about: The service's own table of the retailers that connected (CitiXsys hosting): this container reads it and never writes it.
